run_experiment_all_algos: run an Experiment with all registered algorithm configs on the VMAS BALANCE task with continuous or discrete actions
run_experiment_all_tasks: run an Experiment with IppoConfig or MasacConfig across all VMAS tasks using an MLP model
run_experiment_collect_with_grad: run an Experiment with collect_with_grad enabled to test gradient collection during environment interaction
run_experiment_gnn_model: run an Experiment with a GNN model config on the VMAS NAVIGATION task using IppoConfig, QmixConfig, IsacConfig, or IddpgConfig
run_experiment_gru_model: run an Experiment with a GRU model config on the VMAS NAVIGATION task with optional shared policy and critic parameters
run_experiment_lstm_model: run an Experiment with an LSTM model config on the VMAS NAVIGATION task with optional shared policy and critic parameters
test_reload_trainer: test reloading a saved Experiment trainer from disk for all registered algorithm configs on the VMAS BALANCE task
run_experiment_share_policy_params: run an Experiment with shared or unshared policy parameters using a custom Tanh-activated MLP critic model
